safeguard.tooltip: We never invent achievements, experience, or skills not in your profile.
safeguard.guarantee: 100% Authentic: Always faithful to your real career history

footer.privacyNote: All data stays in your browser storage. Return here anytime from the top logo.
footer.communityNote: If CV Studio helped you land an interview, a star on GitHub helps more people find it.

backup.tooltipFresh: Your career profile has been backed up recently.
backup.tooltipModerate: Several days since your last backup export.
backup.tooltipOld: Warning: Your last backup export is more than 10 days old.
backup.toastMessage: You have made multiple profile edits since your last backup export. Would you like to download an updated copy?

sync.modalSubtitle: Transfer your workspace between PC and mobile with E2EE encryption
sync.exportDescription: Generates a temporary encrypted snapshot of your entire workspace (Master CV, versions, vacancies, and Kanban applications) to scan or open on another device.
sync.scanPrompt: Point your smartphone's native camera at the screen to open your workspace instantly.
sync.importDescription: Paste the sync link generated on your other device or enter the pairing code.
sync.inputLabel: Sync link or Pairing Code (e.g. CV-78K2)
sync.securityNotice: Before overwriting any data, a date and changes comparison will be displayed to ensure you don't accidentally overwrite your latest work.
sync.conflictWarning: ⚠️ Warning: The incoming data is older than your current workspace. You have newer changes on this device. Are you sure you want to overwrite?
sync.cleanNotice: This device has no previous data. The snapshot will be imported cleanly.
sync.newerRemoteNotice: The incoming snapshot is newer than your local data. It is safe to proceed with sync.
sync.backupFirstAdvice: We recommend downloading a safety backup file before overwriting to ensure no data is lost.
sync.settingsCardSubtitle: Transfer your entire workspace (Master CV, versions, vacancies, and Kanban) between PC and smartphone via QR code or ephemeral link with E2EE encryption.
